title: fix(studio): a seeded grouped record page heads its ungrouped fields with the translated Other heading
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCWSFQ2r7bCtNXPUwu3o3ns)_

Fixes #33377

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#1` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5nV6skFMkjLTEGHKL3` · claim 6884066738

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在 Studio 里给声明了字段分组的对象新建完整记录页(或把默认页「转为完整页面」)时,未归入任何分组的字段现在写成带标题的分区,标题是「其他 / Other」的多语言写法(每种内置语言一条),保存后的页面按查看者的语言显示;默认页的预览也显示同样的标题。分组本身的写法不变。
- 为什么改:#33229 之后运行中的记录页已把这些字段放在「其他」标题下,但 Studio 生成的页面仍写成无标题分区,保存后这些字段又看起来属于上一个分组(#33229 的症状回来了)。
- 风险与回滚:只改 Studio 生成和预览页面的方式,不改 spec、不改运行中的记录页、不改已保存的页面(不迁移)。标题用的是 spec 已允许的内联多语言写法,没有写死英文。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDetailSections.ts(`deriveStudioDetailSections` 给分组对象的未分组段加标题,`loadPersistedUngroupedHeading` 生成多语言标题)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx(「转为完整页面」等多语言标题加载好才可用)、ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/anchors.ts(新建完整页的种子)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev,在 Studio 给一个有 fieldGroups 且有未分组字段的对象新建 kind 为 full 的记录页并保存,切到中文打开一条记录:未分组字段在「其他」标题下,而不是挂在上一个分组下面。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`deriveFieldGroupLayout` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, ADR-0085 §5) ends a grouped layout with a keyless bucket of the fields no declared group claims. Since #33372 the running record page draws it under the translated `common.ungroupedSection` heading. Studio's three page builders did not:

| Surface | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Create page, kind `full` (`anchors.ts` `createSeed`) | bucket written `{ columns, fields }`, no heading | `{ label, columns, fields }`, `label` the inline locale map |
| Convert to full page (`PagePreview.tsx` `convertToFull`) | same as the seed | same as the seed |
| Slotted page preview (`PagePreview.tsx` `renderSchema`) | bucket drawn untitled | headed with the translated text the running page draws |

- **The form of the persisted heading.** Measured on the spec before choosing: `record:details` `sections[].label` is an `I18nLabel`, a plain string or an inline locale map; `name` addresses only the per-object `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME.label` bundle key, and no section form reaches a shell key such as `common.ungroupedSection`. A plain string would render one language for every viewer (the order bars a literal "Other"). The inline locale map is the declared translated form, and `record:details` already resolves it per viewer with `pickLocalized`. So a persisted page writes `label` as the map of `common.ungroupedSection` from every catalogue `@object-ui/i18n` ships, keyed by its tag (`en` "Other", `zh-Hans` 「其他」, `zh-Hant`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `ar`). A renderer rule that heads an untitled trailing section was rejected: the spec's `label` describe says an omitted label is "an untitled, borderless section", so that would be the renderer overriding a declaration.
- **`recordDetailSections.ts`**: `deriveStudioDetailSections` no longer returns `undefined` for a grouped object. It returns the synthesizer's own sections (`resolveDetailSections`: `{ group, columns }` per group, then the enumerated bucket) with the bucket headed by `labels.ungrouped`. New `loadPersistedUngroupedHeading(objectDef)` builds the map through `loadBuiltInLocale`, and only when the object's field groups apply, so a flat object fetches no catalogue. A catalogue that fails to load rejects the call rather than saving a partial map. `RecordDetailSectionLabels.ungrouped` widens from `string` to `SectionHeading` (`string` or a locale map).
- **`anchors.ts`**: the full-page seed passes the loaded map. **`PagePreview.tsx`**: the preview passes `t('common.ungroupedSection', 'Other')` (now a memo dependency); "Convert to full page" loads the map for the schema on screen and is enabled once it is in, as it already waited for the schema.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/ui/field-grouping-and-order.mdx` names the Studio-seeded page among the surfaces that draw the heading (the #33372 contract review's nit).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/33377-studio-seed-ungrouped-heading.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` patch. app-shell is private, and console's `dist` ships it.

## Tests

- New `recordDetailSections.studioUngroupedHeading-33377.test.tsx`:
  - the full seed for a grouped object: the group reference equals the synthesizer's, the bucket equals the synthesizer's plus `label`, the label is an object with exactly the shipped language codes, each equal to that catalogue's `common.ungroupedSection`; the sections parse under `RecordDetailsProps`;
  - CONTROL: a flat object seeds a primary section with no heading, no section carries a locale map, and the loader answers the English default;
  - rendered through the real `RecordDetailsRenderer` under `I18nProvider`: the saved seed draws "Other" in `en` and 「其他」 in `zh-CN` (and not the other language), after the group heading and above the ungrouped field's value; the preview's sections draw 「其他」 the same way.
- `PagePreview.slottedDefault-27054.test.tsx`, new describe: Convert to full page on a grouped object writes the group reference unheaded and the bucket under the full map, and the written page passes `validateMetadataDraft` and every block's `ComponentPropsMap` row.
- Rewritten, because they pinned the defect: the grouped CONTROL in `recordDetailSections.agreement-12442.test.ts` (seed equalled the bare synthesizer output; now every section equals it except the bucket's added `label`) and in `PagePreview.test.tsx` (preview equalled the bare synthesizer; now the bucket carries "Other").
- Ablations, one-off through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on 1b987ec5 (`@object-ui/*` resolves to `src` through the vitest aliases, so no rebuild), each restored with the blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - the bucket heading dropped in `deriveStudioDetailSections`: 7 failed / 20 passed over the 4 files (the seed, both rendered seed rows, the rendered preview row, convert-to-full, the preview node, the 12442 grouped row);
  - the loader answering the plain English default for every object: 3 failed / 24 passed (the seed's map row, the zh-CN rendered seed row, convert-to-full). The `en` rendered row stays green, as it should: a plain "Other" reads right in English only.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pages already saved are not migrated.** A full page Studio seeded or converted before this change keeps its untitled bucket and keeps drawing those fields under the last group, as it does today. Its author can give that section a heading in the page designer (`label`, a string or a per-locale value). A slotted page was never affected at runtime: the running app synthesizes it with the record page's own sections, which already carry the heading; only its preview was wrong, and that is fixed here.
- **`buildDefaultPageSchema` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` is unchanged.** Its `fieldGroupSectionReferences` still writes the bucket untitled for a caller that passes no sections. It has no heading to give (no translator, and a published API), and the only callers that persist it are the Studio ones above, which now pass their sections. So `Clause-②: no`: no exported type or output of a published package changes; app-shell is private. `Metadata-protocol: none`: no spec edit, and the written value is one `sections[].label` already accepts.
- **Measured trade-off of the map**: the saved page holds a copy of the catalogue text as of the save. A later rewording of `common.ungroupedSection` does not reach pages already saved, and a language the platform adds later falls back to `en` on those pages (`pickLocalized`'s `en` limb). The running page, which translates live, is unaffected.
- Out of scope, noted for the seat: the same seed persists "More details" (`MORE_DETAILS_DEFAULT_LABEL`) as a plain English string under `name: 'details'`, so on a saved seeded page of an object with no field groups that heading is English for a viewer whose object bundle has no `_sections.details.label`, while the running page translates it through `detail.sectionMoreDetails`. Read on the code, not driven live.

## Verification
